headline: Long-read methods resolve repeats, mobile elements, methylation and phasing
label: Long Read Variant Analysis
summary: Long-read data now support read-level detection of mobile element insertions, promoter methylation, and haplotype-resolved transcript variation.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational resolution of complex genomic variation that depends on long reads or haplotype structure, though not every item shares it. MEIsensor applies deep learning to HiFi reads to classify Alu, LINE1, and SVA insertions. longcallR extends joint SNP calling, phasing, and allele-specific analysis to long-read RNA-seq with high reported benchmark accuracy. A promoter methylome framework uses HiFi reads across 82 vertebrate assemblies to reveal conserved TSS hypomethylation. The H9 telomere-to-telomere diploid reference and LATTE, which quantifies locus-specific transposable element expression from RNA-seq, address related resolution problems at the reference and expression levels. The new element is breadth: mobile element insertions, promoter methylation, transposable element expression, and transcript-level phasing are all resolved at locus or read level.
